wordProblems.q: Liam has $70. Liam buys a toy for $24 and a book for $39. How many dollars does Liam have left?
Jack has $34. Jack earns $21 helping a neighbour, then spends $8 on lunch. How many dollars does Jack have now?
A hall has 7 rows of chairs with 8 chairs in each row. The teacher adds 8 more chairs. How many chairs are there in all?
Owen collects 30 shells on Saturday and 28 shells on Sunday. Owen gives 37 shells to a friend. How many shells does Owen have left?
Ava has 22 buttons. Ava buys twice as many buttons as Ava already has, plus 4 more. How many buttons does Ava have now?
Henry, Ruby and Leo each have 6 pencils. Their teacher gives them 13 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Adam has 34 stickers. Adam gives away 11 stickers, then buys 2 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Adam buy?
There are 29 red cars and 10 blue cars in a car park. 19 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $9. Amelia buys 4 tickets and a snack for $20. How many dollars does Amelia spend in all?
Chloe buys 5 packs of 7 pens and 5 packs of 8 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Chloe buy in all?
78 children go on a school trip. 39 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 3 trays with 6 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 8 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Zoe plants 7 rows of carrots with 6 carrots in each row. Then Zoe plants 7 more carrots. How many carrots did Zoe plant in all?
Jack saves $7 every week for 3 weeks. Then Jack spends $8 on a game. How many dollars does Jack have left?
A library has 4 shelves with 8 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 15 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 5 boxes with 6 apples in each box. The shop sells 22 apples. How many apples are left?
Ava has 57 red beads and 34 blue beads. Ava uses 69 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Ava have left?
A cook has 4 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 7 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Henry scores 43 points in the first game and 13 points in the second game. Henry gets 5 bonus points. How many points does Henry have in all?
A farmer fills 7 baskets with 5 oranges in each basket. He gives 21 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Henry fills 5 jars with 8 strawberries in each jar. Then Henry picks 15 more strawberries. How many strawberries does Henry have in all?
Owen saves $7 every week for 4 weeks. Then Owen buys a kite for $12 and a puzzle for $11. How many dollars does Owen have left?
A school has 4 classes with 5 children in each class. 3 new children join, and 2 children are away today. How many children are at school today?
Mia has 20 ribbons. Her mum gives her twice as many ribbons as she already has, then Mia gives 6 ribbons to a friend. How many ribbons does Mia have now?
A shop has 5 crates with 10 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 31 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Sam scores 14 points on Monday, 30 points on Tuesday and 14 points on Wednesday. How many points does Sam score in all?
Chloe plants 5 rows of beans with 8 seeds in each row. 8 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $6 and a child ticket costs $3. Jack buys 3 adult tickets and 4 child tickets. How many dollars does Jack spend in all?
Omar is reading a book with 72 pages. Omar reads 29 pages on Friday and 10 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 3 baskets with 9 apples in each basket and 3 baskets with 9 pears in each basket. The market sells 19 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
